about: 수령수표증가현황 · 감소현황 — [일자-No.] 는 수표 전표 자체 번호(전표마다 하나씩 늘어난다), 거래처마다 묶어 '거래처명 계'(거래처 없으면 '[] 계') 줄과 '합계'. 수표내역입력(API)으로 거래처 없는 수표 둘 · 있는 수표 하나를 넣고 감소까지 한 뒤 두 화면의 줄 차례 · 소계를 본다(2026-10-13 원본 실측과 같은 모양). 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 증가현황 — '[] 계' 15,000 · '거래처명 계' 20,000 · 합계 35,000
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const today=new Date(Date.now()+9*3600e3).toISOString().slice(0,10);const acc=(await window.__api('GET','/bank-cards/accounts')).body.find((x)=>x.active);const ps=(await window.__api('GET','/partners')).body;const p=(ps.content??ps)[0];const tag=String(Date.now()).slice(-8);const nos=['QA2A'+tag,'QA2B'+tag,'QA2C'+tag];sessionStorage.setItem('nos',JSON.stringify(nos));sessionStorage.setItem('pName',p.name);const mk=(inc,pid,no,amt)=>window.__api('POST','/checks/direct',{type:'RECEIVED',date:today,increase:inc,partnerId:pid,bankAccountId:acc.id,lines:[{checkNo:no,amount:amt,remark:'QA회계2 소계'}]});const r=[await mk(true,null,nos[0],10000),await mk(true,p.id,nos[1],20000),await mk(true,null,nos[2],5000),await mk(false,null,nos[0],10000),await mk(false,p.id,nos[1],20000),await mk(false,null,nos[2],5000)];return r.map((x)=>x.status).join(',')})()

expect:(()=>{const nos=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('nos'));const no=(n)=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((r)=>r.innerText.includes(n));const m=/ -(\d+)$/.exec(t.cells[0].innerText.trim());return m?Number(m[1]):NaN};const a=no(nos[0]),b=no(nos[1]),c=no(nos[2]);return b===a+1&&c===a+2})()
